name: Openhouse
description: Housing navigation, community programs, and support for LGBTQ+ seniors
fullDescription: Openhouse provides affordable housing navigation, community programs, an adult day program, and LGBTQ+-affirming senior housing for LGBTQ+ older adults in San Francisco.
whatTheyOffer:
- Resource and housing navigation, including 1-on-1 housing counseling
- Free online affordable housing workshops and a monthly housing opportunities list
- LGBTQ+-welcoming affordable senior housing at 55 and 95 Laguna (waitlists currently full)
- Club 75 adult day program, run with On Lok
- Community engagement programs and workshops for older adults
- Volunteer opportunities
howToGetIt:
1. Call 415-296-8995 or use the contact form on the website
2. Book a housing counseling appointment or join an online housing workshop
3. Sign up for the monthly affordable housing list
4. Join community programs and activities
5. Laguna housing is for incomes at or below 50% AMI (ages 55+ at 55 Laguna, 62+ at 95 Laguna); waitlists are currently full
keywords: Openhouse, San Francisco, LGBTQ, gay, lesbian, trans, queer, senior housing, affordable housing, housing navigation, seniors, 55+, Club 75, adult day program, aging services
